front: State the RA area cutoff for right atrial enlargement.
back: > 18 cm² measured in the RV-focused apical 4-chamber view at end-systole.

front: Name three normal anatomic RA structures that are commonly mistaken for pathology.
back: 1) Eustachian valve (IVC valve). 2) Chiari network (fenestrated web from embryonic right valve of sinus venosus). 3) Crista terminalis (ridge separating smooth from trabeculated RA — often confused for a mass on TEE).
A fenestrated web-like remnant of the embryonic right valve of the sinus venosus in the RA — a normal variant, not pathologic.

front: Most common source of RA thrombus in a patient without indwelling hardware?
back: Migratory thrombus from a lower extremity deep vein thrombosis ('thrombus-in-transit') — often precedes pulmonary embolism.

front: How does severe TR appear on hepatic vein PW Doppler?
back: Systolic flow reversal in the hepatic vein. (Normal HV has a dominant systolic forward wave.)
